- Continue and finish the existing game as a complete, playable browser game.

- Preserve the existing Emberwake adventure game and address a suspected mobile portrait canvas sizing issue.

- Ran the game in Playwright and saved/inspected `screenshots/current.jpg`.
- Added dynamic canvas resizing in `index.html`, with a taller game view on portrait mobile screens.

### Active
- Finish and test the portrait canvas changes, especially drawing bounds and camera behavior at the new canvas height.
- Validate gameplay in browser and check console errors; finish any needed fixes.

- (none)

1. Inspect the current `index.html` diff and verify portrait layout/canvas behavior in Playwright.
2. Test the start flow and basic movement/attack, then inspect the latest screenshot and console.
3. Remove or retain `screenshots/current.jpg` as appropriate; report assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire game implementation; currently modified for responsive portrait canvas sizing.
- `screenshots/current.jpg`: latest visual-check screenshot; generated after the canvas changes but not yet refreshed after final edits.

- Changes are uncommitted.
